text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 18 · 复古胶片 · 珊瑚红峡湾未来住宅 · 砖红 / 冷灰蓝 / 浅木色.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Film-photographic original retro-future fjord house interior, coral brick-red curved fireplace, pale oak conversation pit with empty linen seating, panoramic window framing blue-gray water and snowy cliffs, overcast Nordic daylight, tactile fabric and glass, restrained analog grain, understated lived-in warmth with no occupants.
Visual medium: vintage film; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit reference multi-view sheet: keep panels A, B, C exactly, remove panel D bottom right because it relocates the fireplace relative to window wall. Reflow A B C into a balanced THREE-panel landscape sheet. Preserve all room details, red freestanding fireplace, sunken circular cream sofa, fjord window, wooden walls, soft photographic light. No people. No new viewpoints.
